summary: Iteration 7 — Production build purity + Railway deployment hardening. Verified `yarn build` produces a clean, deterministic bundle with ZERO react-refresh/HMR references, http-server serves it on :4004 with SPA fallback working for arbitrary React Router routes (/dashboard, /workspace, /share/wiring/anytoken), dev server still functions on :3000 after supervisor restart, all Railway/Docker artifacts present with expected content, craco guard block correctly filters HMR plugins + walks module.rules + aliases react-refresh runtime to false, and backend regression is 100% clean (health, register, login, providers with auth, google 503).
critical_code_review_comments: craco.config.js production guard is solid — filters ReactRefreshPlugin/ReactRefreshWebpackPlugin/HotModuleReplacementPlugin, recursively strips react-refresh from babel loader options across rule/oneOf/rules/use, and aliases 'react-refresh/runtime' + 'react-refresh/babel' to false. Belt-and-braces protection is appropriate.

yarn serve uses http-server with --proxy http://localhost:${PORT}? as SPA fallback — verified working. Note: the '?' at the end of the proxy URL is a workaround for http-server's fallback mechanism; unusual but functional.
Dockerfile uses nginx:1.27-alpine template envsubst pattern — clean multi-stage build (~10s builder step). PORT env correctly substituted in nginx.conf via envsubst on startup.
Backend Dockerfile is minimal but correct — uvicorn on ${PORT:-8001}, healthcheck /api/health wired in railway.toml.
Build is deterministic — main bundle hash main.fdea9ee4.js identical across two consecutive builds.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (build purity + serve + SPA + dev + Railway artifacts)

test_credentials: Registered fresh TEST_it7_<ts>@example.com at runtime — no persistent seed
context_for_next_testing_agent: Production bundle is now guaranteed react-refresh-free via craco.config.js NODE_ENV=production guard. If the Railway blank-screen issue reappears, the cause is deployment config (Railway ignoring Dockerfile/railway.toml) rather than the build itself. `yarn serve` uses http-server (not `serve` package) so previous path-to-regexp crash cannot recur. Bundle path: /app/frontend/build/static/js/main.<hash>.js (188.08 kB gzip).
rca of the issue: Original prod blank screen was caused by Railway running `yarn start` (CRA dev server) instead of the production build — dev server injects react-refresh runtime which throws 'React Refresh runtime should not be included in the production bundle' in non-dev NODE_ENV. Fix combines: (1) craco.config.js hard-guard so even if a plugin tries to inject HMR/refresh in a NODE_ENV=production build, it is filtered + aliased-away; (2) new `yarn serve` = http-server (not the buggy `serve` pkg with path-to-regexp crash); (3) Dockerfile+railway.toml pin Railway deployment to the built nginx image so `yarn start` cannot be reached in production. All three layers verified.
